cause: SFC baseline admitted surface shear as tangent speed
mechanism: At contact, ~4 N shear in XY plus 120 N/m hold (0.24 N at 2 mm) lets axis-decoupled SFC command tangent velocity. The probe slides on the unknown surface and normal load rises from the 2 N setpoint to 16-25 N. Not a scheduler failure.
fix: Project the force residual onto the outward normal during baseline only. PATH keeps the full residual.
